description: Flerovium is a synthetic chemical element with symbol Fl and atomic number 114. It is an extremely radioactive, superheavy transactinide element in the p-block of the periodic table, located in period 7 as the heaviest known member of the carbon group. Very little is known about flerovium since it can only be produced one atom at a time and all known isotopes are short-lived.
uses: The source text does not describe practical uses for flerovium.
characteristics: Flerovium is unexpectedly volatile for a group 14 element and shows very high volatility, possibly even gaseous at standard temperature and pressure, with behavior similar to copernicium in reactions with gold. It also appears to show some metallic properties consistent with it being the heavier homologue of lead. The most stable known isotope, 289Fl, has a half-life of approximately 2.1 seconds, with the unconfirmed 290Fl potentially having a longer half-life of 19 seconds.
